visibility: Evaluator input only. Do not mount this file into an agent workspace, send it to a model, or use it as training data.

required: The function computes union length for sorted or unsorted intervals and does not mutate the input.
It raises ValueError for a reversed interval, including when other intervals are valid.
automatic_failure: Wrong output or exception behavior on any required test case.
Returning prose or Markdown that cannot be recovered as the requested Python function under the frozen extraction rule.

required: Confirms Riley can attend Friday at 2:00 p.m.
Says the checklist is still under review with no confirmed completion date.
Requests Casey's latest agenda.
Uses a friendly professional greeting and sign-off in the requested length.
automatic_failure: Promises a completion date or claims the checklist is ready.
Changes the agreed time or omits the main confirmation/request.
P-D02.optional_score: Minor wording edits are acceptable. Score tone and concision separately from factual adequacy.

required: Applies the 14-calendar-day rule from [B] and states that [B] supersedes [A].
Requests the receipt and activity ID together, with [B] cited.
Uses [C] for parking eligibility and says the supplied text cannot establish whether $40 exceeds a cap.
automatic_failure: Uses 30 days or implies exceptions survive the revision.
Invents a cap or treats the missing cap as a guarantee of reimbursement.

required: Explains the approved 12-unit pilot and deferred expansion.
States Morgan's Monday request and the June 14 room reservation.
Indicates that the delivery date is unconfirmed. June 7 may be omitted or identified as an unadopted suggestion.
Uses exactly three bullets.
automatic_failure: Treats June 7 as confirmed or implies expansion was approved.
Invents an owner, commitment or delivery date.

required: Returns one valid JSON object with the requested keys and value types.
Uses null for the unreported tax.
automatic_failure: Fabricates tax from the difference between subtotal and charge.
Wrong values, keys, types, or additional text outside the JSON object.

required: Morning handled 54 boxes and afternoon handled 42.
Explains why throughput cannot be compared without shift durations or direct rate evidence.
automatic_failure: Interprets a higher count as a faster rate or uses inconsistent counts.

required: Orders the failed and successful member7 logins, then the service-account read and scheduler start.
States that the records attribute the file read to backup-svc and do not establish a member7 file read.
Cites relevant record IDs and identifies one appropriate source for attribution, such as session-correlated file audit events.
automatic_failure: Attributes the read to member7 or claims the scheduler event proves why the earlier read happened.
Invents evidence or a confirmed compromise.

required: subtotal preserves its signature and handles zero, absent, and positive quantities.
A meaningful regression test is added and executed.
automatic_failure: Zero adds a nonzero charge or the default for omitted quantity changes.
The solution alters the price for unrelated inputs or defeats the existing tests.

required: Preserves old calls, supports keyword grouping by zone including missing zones, and rejects other modes.
New public tests are meaningful and executed.
automatic_failure: Regresses the old signature or mutates caller data.
Incorrectly combines SKUs across zones, drops unassigned rows, or accepts unsupported grouping.

required: Unchanged production parser. Submitted unittest tests pass on the original implementation.
The tests reject all specified mutations when each mutant replaces the original in its own scoring copy.
automatic_failure: Changes duration.py or writes tests that pass despite a required mutation.

required: Uses one shared channel loop, preserving input event order, each event's channel order, and duplicate supported channels.
Ignores unsupported statuses and channels; preserves send/hold mapping.
Explains the order rule and adds and runs a regression test.
automatic_failure: Drops duplicates, reorders actions, changes flags, or emits actions for unsupported inputs.
Keeps duplicated channel traversal.

required: The module invocation succeeds from project root for the supplied CSV and a second compatible CSV.
total_cents remains importable and supports its existing row format.
README documents the exact command and sample output.
automatic_failure: Hardcodes sample.csv or 500, requires extra dependencies, or breaks the public function.
